activation_steps_prepend: Read the scope and choose a new run-specific report path under artifacts/Review. For an RVC SASD review without explicit lenses, use adversarial, edge-case-hunter, and sasd; add prose only when editing prose is requested.
review_guidance: Report in Korean while preserving requirement IDs, process IDs and source identifiers.
Use the RVC source documents as evidence; never impose a minimum finding count.
Review does not authorize changing approved artifacts or advancing a development phase.
workflow.output_preferences: Include requirement references, severity, confirmed defect versus ambiguity versus optional improvement, evidence, minimal correction, and unreviewed scope. Record executed checks separately.

lenses.name: RVC evidence-based adversarial review
lenses.instruction: Read {project-root}/docs/verification/bmad-lenses.md and apply only its adversarial section. Return canonical BMAD finding fields. Zero findings is valid. Do not load the upstream minimum-count adversarial lens.

lenses.name: Edge-Case Hunter
lenses.when: Content with behavior to trace: code, diffs, and the specs, requirements, plans, and stories that define behavior. Skip for prose documents with no behavioral surface.
lenses.instruction: Load `references/lens-edge-case-hunter.md` from the skill root and follow it.

lenses.name: Verification Gap
lenses.when: Reviewed inside a repo where tests can be searched and read.
lenses.instruction: Load `references/lens-verification-gap.md` from the skill root and follow it.

lenses.name: Editorial Structure
lenses.when: Documents whose shape is the author's to change.
lenses.instruction: Load `references/lens-structure.md` from the skill root and follow it.

lenses.name: Editorial Prose
lenses.instruction: Load `references/lens-prose.md` from the skill root and follow it.

lenses.name: RVC SASD consistency and design review
lenses.when: RVC requirements, SA, SD, or claims of their consistency with implementation and tests.
lenses.instruction: Read {project-root}/docs/verification/bmad-lenses.md and apply its sasd section to the requested scope using live source artifacts. Return canonical BMAD finding fields.
